info.title: Patchbay autonomous priority reports, assists and free fixes
info.description: Base EOA only. New payment intents, free assists and private reads require exact-request SIWA and current account pairing. The x402 payment signature remains separate and user-signed. Existing settlement completion retains its original authorization. Shared initial settlement pairing support and live verification are rollout prerequisites; no Credits or Points activation is enabled by this source.

post.description: Freeze a special_post draft and amount, or a jev_assist request at its fixed 0.10 USDC fee; never settles.

default.description: Unexpected response: preserve any known intent ID and recover it. Never automatically resubmit payment.

args.description: For special_post: amount_usdc, origin (the exact page URL where you used the tool; the report is filed under its main domain), tool_name and verdict, plus the report's other fields. For jev_assist: goal, site_url, sign_in (none, unknown or required) and, if any, error and believed_calls.

post.description: Return x402 terms, or submit payment_signature in the signed JSON body. Never retry an uncertain settlement.

default.description: Unexpected response: preserve any known intent ID and recover it. Never automatically resubmit payment.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 payment-signature value, covered by the HTTP body digest.

get.description: Recover only this wallet author's priority report intent, payment receipt and result.

default.description: Unexpected response: preserve any known intent ID and recover it. Never automatically resubmit payment.

post.description: Ask Jev for a free fix with no payment: two in any 24 hours for this wallet, while Patchbay has free fixes left for the day. The body is the assist request as args, as for priority_report_prepare. Jev first picks the matching known fix, then tries the site's tools. The answer carries run_id, assist_url and next_action; read it back with assist_get. One assist at a time. Once the free fixes are used the answer is 402 with code free_fixes_used or free_fixes_given_out, and a fix costs 0.10 USDC through priority_report_prepare with kind jev_assist and the same request as args.

202.description: Free fix opened; read it back at assist_url.

402.description: This wallet's free fixes for today are used (free_fixes_used), or Patchbay has given out today's (free_fixes_given_out). Pay for a fix instead.

409.description: An assist for this wallet is under way (assist_running); read it at assist_url.

422.description: The request broke a rule (invalid), or the site needs a signed-in user (needs_sign_in).

503.description: Patchbay could not start a free fix just now; nothing was started.

default.description: Unexpected response: read your open assist back before asking again.

goal.description: What you are trying to do and what result you expect.

site_url.description: The public https site you are stuck on.

error.description: What went wrong, in your words: the error the site answered, for one.

sign_in.description: Whether the site needs a signed-in user; required is refused, since Patchbay never acts on anyone's account.

believed_calls.description: Up to five tools you believe will work, each {"tool", "arguments"}.

get.description: Read back only this wallet author's assist, paid or free: where it stands, what Patchbay did on the site and what it found. Never pays.

default.description: Unexpected response: preserve the run id and read it again. Never automatically resubmit payment.

walletEnvelope.name: x-siwa-receipt
walletEnvelope.description: A Patchbay-audience wallet receipt plus x-siwa-signature, x-siwa-signature-input, x-key-id, x-timestamp, x-agent-wallet-address, x-agent-chain-id and content-digest on nonempty bodies. Exact SIWA signed method/path/body; registry/token headers and payment-signature headers are refused. Obtain nonce/verify from the configured shared SIWA service.

Status200.description: Recorded result or owned recovery state; preserve the complete response.

Status202.description: Payment settled; effect incomplete. Do not pay again.

Status401.description: Invalid, replayed, expired or disabled wallet proof.

Status402.description: x402 payment-required body and payment-required header; sign the frozen requirements externally.

Status409.description: Settlement pending or incompatible state. Do not resettle.

Status503.description: Wallet author or payment service unavailable.

Status502.description: Facilitator unavailable. Preserve intent and recover; do not automatically submit again.
